{{Top|leg}}
A '''circuit disrupter''' was a device for bypassing electronic security mechanisms, such as a door lock or a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] safeguards protecting classified data. It could also immobilize a droid.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Traitor's Gambit]]'', the device is twice spelled "circuit disrupter" and twice "circuit-disrupter." As the term appears nowhere else in [[canon]], it is impossible to say which spelling is canonically correct.
